Given the form is opened from the menu, when it shows, then no cake is chosen and the list of cakes offers only cakes.
Given an address naming a cake no longer on the list, when it opens, then the form shows with no cake chosen.

fields.name: Order a cake for pick-up
fields.statement: When a customer sends an order with a cake, a pick-up day, their name and their phone number, the website shall record it for pick-up at the bakery.

fields.says: Given Layer cake, a pick-up day, Rosa Bell and 07700 900142, when she selects Place order, then the order shows in Staff orders under To do with those details.
Given an order just sent, when the customer selects Place order a second time, then one order is recorded.
Given the note is left empty, when the order is sent, then it is recorded with no note.
Given two customers send an order for the same cake at the same moment, when both arrive, then both are recorded, each with its own number.
Given a customer with no account, when they send a complete order, then it is recorded with nothing to sign in to.

fields.name: Say what needs fixing
fields.statement: If a customer sends an order with a detail missing or not accepted, then the website shall keep what they entered and say beside each such detail what to fix.

fields.says: Given no name is entered, when the customer selects Place order, then Please tell us your name shows under the name and everything entered stays.
Given the phone number is abc, when the customer selects Place order, then Please enter a phone number we can ring shows under the phone number.
Given no cake is chosen, when the customer selects Place order, then Please choose a cake shows under the cake.
Given no pick-up day is chosen, when the customer selects Place order, then Please choose a pick-up day shows under the day.
Given three details need fixing, when the customer selects Place order, then Please check the 3 details below shows above the form and each says what to fix.

fields.name: Pick-up days the bakery can do
fields.statement: The website shall accept a pick-up day only if the bakery is open on it and it leaves the bakery its notice.

fields.says: Given a pick-up day exactly the notice away on a day the bakery is open, when the order is sent, then it is accepted.
Given a pick-up day one day closer than the notice, when the order is sent, then We need more notice for that day. Please choose a later one shows under the day.
Given a day the bakery is closed, when the order is sent, then We are closed that day. Please choose another shows under the day.
Given a day that has passed, when the order is sent, then That day has passed. Please choose a later one shows under the day.

fields.name: Say the order is placed
fields.statement: When an order is recorded, the website shall show the customer its order number, the cake, the pick-up day and where to collect it.

fields.says: Given an order is recorded, when Order placed shows, then it holds the order number, the cake, the pick-up day and the bakery's address.
Given Order placed is open, when the customer reloads it, then the same order shows and no second order is recorded.
Given no order has just been placed, when Order placed is opened, then it says We cannot find an order to show, and offers Order a cake.
Given Order placed is open, when the customer reads it, then it says to ring the bakery, quoting the order number, to change or cancel the order.

fields.name: When an order cannot be placed
fields.statement: If the website cannot record an order, then the website shall tell the customer it was not placed, with the bakery's phone number, and keep what they entered.

fields.says: Given the order cannot be recorded, when the customer selects Place order, then We could not place your order shows above the button with the bakery's phone number, and what they entered stays.
Given that message shows, when the customer selects Place order again and it is recorded, then one order is recorded.

fields.name: Show the hours and address
fields.statement: The website shall show the bakery's opening hours and address on every screen customers see.

fields.says: Given any screen a customer sees, when they read its foot, then it shows the opening hours, the address and the phone number.
Given the home page, when a customer reads Find us, then it shows all seven days, a day the bakery is closed saying Closed.
Given a customer on a phone, when they select the phone number, then their phone offers to ring it.
Given the list of products cannot be fetched, when a customer opens the home page, then the hours and address still show.

fields.name: See the orders
fields.statement: While a member of staff is signed in, the website shall show them the orders, the soonest pick-up day first.

fields.says: Given orders for today, tomorrow and Saturday, when staff open the orders, then they show in that order, each with its number, pick-up day, cake, customer's name, phone number and note.
Given one order to do and one ready, when staff open the orders, then each shows under its own heading, To do or Ready.
Given no orders, when staff open the orders, then it says No orders yet.
Given an order placed while the list is open, when staff select Refresh, then it shows.
Given the orders cannot be fetched, when staff open them, then it says We could not load the orders, and offers Try again.

fields.name: Mark an order ready
fields.statement: When a member of staff marks an order ready, the website shall show it as ready.

fields.says: Given an order under To do, when staff select Mark ready, then it moves to Ready.
Given an order marked ready by mistake, when staff select Put back, then it returns to To do.
Given two members of staff with the same order open, when the second selects Mark ready after the first, then it stays ready and nothing fails.
Given the mark cannot be saved, when staff select Mark ready, then the order stays under To do and says That did not save. Try again.

fields.name: Only staff see the orders
fields.statement: If someone who is not signed in as staff opens the orders, then the website shall ask for the staff password and show no order.

fields.says: Given someone not signed in, when they open the orders' address, then the staff password is asked for and no order shows.
Given the right staff password, when it is sent, then the orders show.
Given a wrong staff password, when it is sent, then That password is not right shows and no order shows.
Given a member of staff selects Sign out, when they go back, then no order shows and the password is asked for.

fields.name: pick-up
fields.means: The customer collects the cake at the bakery, on the day they chose.

fields.name: notice
fields.means: How long before a pick-up day the bakery needs the order. How long that is waits for Q5.

fields.name: ready
fields.means: The staff's mark on an order: the cake can be collected.

fields.name: customer
fields.who: Anyone who comes to the website to see what the bakery bakes, order a cake, or find its hours and address. They have no account.

fields.name: staff
fields.who: The people who work at the bakery, who see the orders and mark them ready.
